raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Diligent professional with extensive knowledge in Business Operations & Analysis, Payments Reconciliation, Fin-Crime operations focused on optimizing processes and upholding compliance in payments sector, boosting operational accuracy and client satisfaction.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES

Business analysis

Leadership and problem solving

Payment processing and reconciliation

Stakeholder engagement

Risk management

Effective communication

Client relationship management

SWIFT / Nostro recon operations

Cross-border payments

ISO 20022 MX Payments
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Sr. Business Analyst / Aston Carter
05/2025 – 12/2025
Client-Wells Fargo

Monitoring payments (MT103, 202,202cov and others) both cross border /domestic, ensuring smooth processing from queue.

Liaising with sanctions, technology and other internal stakeholder teams for smooth processing of payments to clients.

Act as a bridge between tech teams and business teams, worked in Manual Payments/wires environment and E2E Payment flow.

Elicited, analyzed, and documented Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Functional Requirements Documents (FRD), and User Stories for payments migration.

Created BRDs, FRDs, and test cases for pain.001, pacs.008, pacs.004, camt.053.

Directed team management and delivery governance, driving high performance, process excellence, and adherence to SLAs/KPIs in a regulated environment.

Testing and identifying application if have any defects and providing suggestion for improvement and enhancement.

Coordinated UAT execution with business users, tracked defects in JIRA, and managed triage and resolution with development and QA teams through to sign-off

Maintained traceability matrices linking business objectives to functional requirements, test cases, and UAT sign-off criteria across multiple concurrent work streams

Experienced in Writing test cases, Executing test cases and setting the Acceptance Criteria
Worked in JIRA for issue tracking, reporting; Confluence for knowledge management and documentation

Validated data integrity of payment message transformations between MT103/MT202 and ISO 20022 equivalents, ensuring compliance with scheme rules and internal standards

Supported digital transformation programmes by defining target operating models for ISO 20022 migration, including pain.001, pacs.008, and CAMT message adoption
Worked in payment initiation channels Swift, Chips, ACH, Fed.

Tools used: Grafana dashboard, payment tracker, GMTS, EMTS
Manager – Business Analyst / State Street Services Pvt ltd
02/2023 - 01/2025

Led end-to-end operations for a high-performing team focused on fraud prevention, chargeback management, and client servicing, ensuring delivery of key operational metrics and sales targets.

Responsible for payments reconciliation/investigations, failed transactions and settlement transformation initiatives for global clients for cross-border payment initiatives using MT103, MT202, MT202Cov, and MX formats (pain.001, pacs.008, pacs.009).

Acted as primary liaison with key clients, maintaining proactive and regular engagement to align with expectations and enhance satisfaction.
Monitored and reconciled fraud prevention workflows including Sanctions, OFAC.  Worked on detailed message mapping for ISO 20022 formats (pain.001, pacs.008, pacs.009, pain.002, MT103, MT202, MT202Cov, etc.) and legacy SWIFT MTs.

Led end-to-end Financial Crime Operations (Sanctions, Transaction Monitoring, Fraud Investigations) ensuring timely and accurate delivery across global stakeholders.
Managed/developed the Client relationships via operational client review meetings and day to day ops liaison within key work stream Analyze and document business requirements for Payments processing, reconciliations to identify areas for efficiency improvement.

Ensured BA artefacts and solution designs adhered to AML, sanctions screening, and regulatory compliance frameworks applicable to payments and retail banking operation

Coordinated with Tech teams, worked with multiple Stakeholders to ensure alignment with business needs by writing Business requirements.

Coordinated UAT execution with business users, tracked defects in JIRA, and managed triage and resolution with development and QA teams through to sign-off

Proficient in JIRA for issue tracking, reporting; Confluence for knowledge management and documentation
Validated data integrity of payment message transformations between MT103/MT202 and ISO 20022 equivalents, ensuring compliance with scheme rules and internal standards

Supported digital transformation programmes by defining target operating models for ISO 20022 migration, including pain.001, pacs.008, and CAMT message adoption
Oversaw reconciliation of client receipts and transactions, ensuring regulatory compliance and the safeguarding of client assets.

Experienced in Writing test cases, Executing test cases and setting the Acceptance Criteria

Recording the issues, mitigation ways in SOP ensuring the team is prepared to handle in future.
Maintained accurate documentation of investigations and resolutions for audit purposes. 
Reviewing SOP's whenever any changes incurred in the process and getting signed off from the stakeholders.
Lead Representative – Operations & Business Analyst / BNY Mellon Pvt Ltd
06/2016 - 01/2023

Conducted AS-IS/TO-BE process analysis in identifying operational gaps and recommending automation or re- engineering opportunities that reduced manual processing time
Worked on migration project of ISO 20022 migration, including pain.001, pacs.008 and CBPR+

Elicited, analyzed, and documented Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Functional Requirements Documents (FRD), and User Stories for end-to-end payments

Executed multi-phase reconciliation projects for cross-border payments. Ensure timely and accurate settlement of securities transactions across multiple markets.

Delivered continuous improvements in SWIFT message processing, enhancing reconciliation and settlement accuracy. Experienced in handling payments related to subscription and redemption

Experienced with SWIFT messaging standards (MT103, MT202, MX), ISO 20022 message types.
Experience in user story writing, story mapping

Validated SWIFT messages (MT103, MT202, MT202 COV, MT199, MT999) including for high-value cross-border payments to support settlement and investigations processes.

Developed and executed strategies for operational efficiency, reducing processing times and enhancing client satisfaction.

Processing and disputing credit card charge backs and inquiries to recover funds - including investigations and communications with external partners.

Investigated and resolved payment issues, internal case management systems, ensuring timely resolution and regulatory compliance.

Coordinate with custodians, depositories, and counterparties to resolve settlement discrepancies. Provided insights and feedback to improve payment processing workflows and minimize recurring investigation cases.

Experienced in Writing test cases, Executing test cases and setting the Acceptance Criteria

Facilitated UAT cycles and supported production go-lives across regions.

Assisted in the implementation of fraud detection tools and automated monitoring systems.

Provided Enhancement idea and moved the manual process into automated one (via VB based macro).

Conducted detailed business analysis to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement in investment banking processes.

Collaborate with technology teams to design and implement system enhancements that improve operational efficiency.
 Worked as one of the BCP coordinator for the department and conducting sessions on Risk management and preparation of Audit documents on regular intervals for internal, external audits, RFP's, RFI'S.
Conducting Root Cause Analysis of Errors incurred and suggests controls subsequently.
Specialist in Internal Reconciliations team / State Street HCL Services Pvt ltd
03/2013 - 02/2016

Reconciliations of Cash & Security position, Processing of Income, Dividend breaks between Accounting and Custody books.

Settlement of trades, Corporate actions and Pay-downs wherever applicable.

Defining and creating processes maps & preparation of SOPs, KPIs and Escalation metric. Posting journal entries, Accruals, expenses, management fees to GL account and adjustment entries in accounting system as per requirement.
Worked with Quality team to improve the standard of the process and in automation activities.  Completed Yellow Belt Certification as part of LEAN program in HCL.
Associate / TCS E-Serve Pvt Ltd
12/2009 - 03/2013
Worked as an Associate in Nostro reconciliations team for Payments Investigations process, SWIFT payments and processing wire payments to internal and external parties.

Experience in SWIFT message types MT103, MT202, MT599, MT500, 509 & 517 to other counterparty banks / financial institutions for further proceeds.

Experienced in other global payment modes such as SEPA, FED, Chips & Faster payments.

Exposure to control process in reconciliations and payments & handled MIS for the team.
